denominator: 30 deliberately selected clauses; not a random ERPNext sample

rules.requirement: A purchase order line quantity is positive
rules.limit: Pointwise clause only; referenced original quantities must be resolved faithfully. No writer induction or ERPNext parity claim.

rules.requirement: Received quantity is nonnegative for a normal receipt
rules.limit: Pointwise clause only; referenced original quantities must be resolved faithfully. No writer induction or ERPNext parity claim.

rules.requirement: Received quantity cannot exceed ordered quantity with zero over-receipt tolerance
rules.limit: Pointwise clause only; referenced original quantities must be resolved faithfully. No writer induction or ERPNext parity claim.

rules.requirement: Accepted quantity is nonnegative for a normal receipt
rules.limit: Pointwise clause only; referenced original quantities must be resolved faithfully. No writer induction or ERPNext parity claim.

rules.requirement: Rejected quantity is nonnegative for a normal receipt
rules.limit: Pointwise clause only; referenced original quantities must be resolved faithfully. No writer induction or ERPNext parity claim.

rules.requirement: Delivered quantity equals accepted plus rejected quantities
rules.limit: Pointwise clause only; referenced original quantities must be resolved faithfully. No writer induction or ERPNext parity claim.

rules.requirement: Accepted quantity cannot exceed delivered quantity
rules.limit: Pointwise clause only; referenced original quantities must be resolved faithfully. No writer induction or ERPNext parity claim.

rules.requirement: A stock return line quantity is negative
rules.limit: Pointwise clause only; referenced original quantities must be resolved faithfully. No writer induction or ERPNext parity claim.

rules.requirement: The magnitude of a return cannot exceed its original delivery quantity
rules.limit: Pointwise clause only; referenced original quantities must be resolved faithfully. No writer induction or ERPNext parity claim.

rules.requirement: A credit note total is nonpositive
rules.reason: Needs pinned currency and monetary scale semantics; a dimensionless sign check is not evidence for monetary enforcement.

rules.requirement: Billed quantity cannot exceed ordered quantity with zero over-billing tolerance
rules.limit: Pointwise clause only; referenced original quantities must be resolved faithfully. No writer induction or ERPNext parity claim.

rules.requirement: A normal payment amount is nonnegative
rules.reason: Needs pinned currency and monetary scale semantics; a dimensionless sign check is not evidence for monetary enforcement.

rules.requirement: Disallow negative stock by item, warehouse and posting time
rules.reason: Needs a complete partition/history fold, not a supplied balance scalar.

rules.requirement: Issue stock using the oldest eligible cost layers
rules.reason: Needs ordered lot allocation and valuation correspondence, not pointwise arithmetic.

rules.requirement: Value an issue at the prior moving average
rules.reason: Needs historical exact quantity/value folds and rounding correspondence.

rules.requirement: A serial number cannot be held in two warehouses
rules.reason: Needs global uniqueness over holdings plus concurrent writer coverage.

rules.requirement: Do not deliver an expired batch
rules.reason: Needs effective-date batch lookup with the transaction read set.

rules.requirement: A stock transfer preserves quantity across both locations
rules.reason: Needs atomic multi-object effects and a partitioned conservation law.

rules.requirement: Stock value changes agree with inventory GL postings
rules.reason: Needs cross-module unit/book/account bindings and complete writer closure.

rules.requirement: Every journal balances debits and credits per company/book/currency
rules.reason: A supplied debit/credit total would be an untrusted surrogate; needs entry fold.

rules.requirement: Journal entry accounts match company and currency settings
rules.reason: Needs typed account/company/currency links, not currency strings alone.

rules.requirement: Refuse postings in a closed accounting period
rules.reason: Needs effective-dated period lookup across all posting writers.

rules.requirement: Cancellation appends reversals instead of deleting ledger entries
rules.reason: Needs before/after history and action-to-ledger correspondence.

rules.requirement: Cannot cancel a document with outstanding dependent documents
rules.reason: Needs a complete absence/partition read and related-document state.

rules.requirement: Round invoice totals using configured precision and rounding method
rules.reason: Needs exact scale, rounding mode and effective configuration parity.

rules.requirement: Approval author must have the required role on this revision
rules.reason: Needs trusted actor authorization and revision-bound approval evidence.

rules.requirement: Editing an approved amount invalidates its approval
rules.reason: Needs prior revision and all mutation paths, not an approved Boolean.

rules.requirement: Value returned goods at their original delivery cost
rules.reason: Needs immutable original allocation links and valuation history.

rules.requirement: Posting date must belong to an active fiscal year
rules.reason: Needs effective date-range membership in configured fiscal-year objects.

rules.requirement: Reconciliation adjustments preserve ledger history and account for variance
rules.reason: Needs multi-ledger historical comparison and explicit balancing effects.
